About.title: About KeydTech
About.subtitle: A Mogadishu technology company building the digital backbone of Somali business.
About.story: KeydTech started as an Odoo ERP specialist — and that remains our strongest offering. Today we operate as a full technology company: we design apps, build websites, and deliver the systems businesses need to sell, stock, invoice, and grow. From neighborhood shops to expanding enterprises, we turn messy tools into one clear digital operation.
About.storySecondary: We work side by side with owners and teams in Mogadishu and across Somalia. That local context — market rhythms, cashflow realities, and how staff actually work — is what makes our software stick.
About.mission: Make world-class technology accessible, practical, and profitable for Somali businesses — whether that’s a flagship Odoo ERP, a custom app, or a high-converting website.
